newsitem.title: INDIA: At least six policemen die in India mine blast.
newsitem.headline: At least six policemen die in India mine blast.

text.p: At least six policemen were killed in India's southern Andhra Pradesh state on Friday when their jeep was blown up by a mine, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
Maoist militants also known as Naxalites belonging to the People's War Group (PWG) were suspected of planting the mine, it said.
PTI quoted a senior police official as saying the jeep had been on its way to the Lothugedda area from Annavaram.
The PWG controls large forest tracts straddling the neighbouring states of Madhya Pradesh, Orissa and Maharashtra.
The group, called Naxalites after the Indian town of Naxalbari where the movement originated, has a large number of splinter groups each operating in its own "liberated zone".
